summary: When the OS blocks installing Ansible with pip, pipx is a widely available alternative.
questions: pip won't let me install Ansible on my system, what can I use?
Can I install Ansible with pipx?

answer_card.title: Use pipx when pip is blocked
answer_card.answer_md: Some operating systems prevent installing packages like Ansible with `pip`. In that case use **pipx**, which is widely available. See the pipx docs to install pipx itself.
